title: EU Policy & Outreach Partnership Technical Assistance Programme in Mexico & Central America (2021-2025)
executive_summary: The EU Policy & Outreach Partnership Technical Assistance Programme (2021-2025), funded by the European Union and implemented by the Organization of Ibero-American States (OEI), aims to strengthen EU public diplomacy and partnerships in Mexico and Central America. The programme focuses on enhancing the EU’s engagement with key stakeholders—including business leaders, policymakers, influencers, and civil society—through strategic outreach, cultural activities, and policy dialogue. Key activities include forums on democracy and digital transformation, cultural events, workshops, and academic exchanges. The initiative seeks to increase the visibility of EU priorities, foster mutual trust, and build a sustainable stakeholder network, directly benefiting over 1,000 individuals and aligning with SDG 17 on partnerships.
characteristics: EU-funded technical assistance programme (2021-2025) implemented by OEI to strengthen EU public-diplomacy and partnerships in Mexico and Central America.
Aims to support EU policy implementation by enhancing engagement with business, decision-makers, influencers, and civil society through strategic outreach and cultural activities.
Focuses on increasing EU visibility, building mutual trust, and consolidating stakeholder networks for sustained policy dialogue.
Activities include forums on key themes, cultural events, workshops, and academic exchanges, aligned with SDG 17 (Partnerships).
practical_applications: The EU Policy & Outreach Partnership - Technical Assistance Programme in Mexico & Central America (2021-2025) is being implemented by the Organization of Ibero-American States (OEI) with EU financing, providing technical assistance to strengthen EU public-diplomacy outreach and partnerships in Mexico and Central America.
The programme includes forums on democracy, digital transformation, climate, and inclusive growth as active initiatives.
It organizes cultural events (such as film, literature, and art) to showcase shared values between the EU and the region.
Workshops are being conducted for journalists, policy-makers, and civil-society leaders to enhance engagement and understanding.
The programme supports academic exchanges and think-tank research collaboration between the EU and regional partners.
The project is funded by the European Union and directly benefits over 1,000 individuals, with implementation by OEI (Secretariat-General) from May 2021 to May 2025.

top_actors.name: European Union
top_actors.justification: The European Union is the central actor: it is the financier, the source of the policies and priorities being implemented, and the main subject of the outreach and partnership activities. The entire programme is designed to strengthen the EU's engagement and visibility in Mexico and Central America.

top_actors.name: Organisation of Ibero-American States
top_actors.justification: The OEI is the implementing agency for the programme, responsible for executing the technical assistance and outreach activities. Its role is crucial for the operationalization and success of the EU's objectives in the region.

top_actors.name: Civil Society Organisations
top_actors.justification: Civil society organisations are a primary target group and direct beneficiaries of the programme. They are key to achieving the project's goals of building trust, fostering dialogue, and amplifying the EU's values and priorities among diverse audiences.

top_themes.name: Bi-regional Cooperation
top_themes.justification: The document's central focus is on strengthening EU engagement and partnerships with Mexico and Central America, emphasizing bi-regional cooperation. This theme is directly tied to the project's objectives, funding, and expected results, and is referenced throughout the text as the main purpose of the technical assistance programme.

top_themes.name: Digital & Technological Partnerships
top_themes.justification: Digital and technological partnerships are highlighted as a key area of engagement, with specific mention of forums on digital transformation and collaboration with business, industry, and academic stakeholders. This theme is strategically important for modernizing cooperation and is explicitly listed among the priority thematic areas.

top_themes.name: Digital Agenda
top_themes.justification: The digital agenda, including digital transformation, is mentioned as a focus of project activities (e.g., forums, workshops). While important, it is presented as one of several thematic priorities rather than the overarching goal, making it slightly less central than the broader cooperation and partnership themes.
